text:
maria: Quick sync — need to lock PRD for console export & purge policy. Customers want per-tenant retention tiers, scheduled exports to customer S3, and a way to preview/restore recent exports. Can we do 30m today? Preferably before Thursday roadmap cut.

sam: I can join. Questions: retention enforcement server-side vs client-side? server-side seems safer. Also need to spec export job backpressure, and failure semantics (partial exports).

jess: I'll make two UX mocks: 1) retention tiers on Organization > Data retention, 2) export job history modal with status + retry. Manual export + auto-export toggle. Need acceptance criteria to wire the states.

ashley: SRE notes — big exporter bursts can cause egress spikes. We need token-bucket throttling per-tenant, circuit breaker on repeated failures, and clear monitoring. Also log sampling for traces to avoid storage blowup.

oliver: For prioritization: recommend MLP (minimum lovable product) with: retention tiers + manual export + export history. Auto-export and restore as follow-ups. Launch criteria: metrics (successful exports >=95% in canary), cost delta <5% for avg tenant, UX QA signed off.

maria: Draft acceptance criteria (copy/paste please review):
- `Retention tiers`: admin can set 7/30/90/365/Custom days per org
- `Export`: user can trigger manual export to a pre-configured S3 destination; export must be resumable on partial failures
- `Scheduled export`: can configure weekly/daily exports per org (MVP opt-out)
- `Purge`: data older than retention automatically queued for purge; purge must have soft-delete 48h window before irrevocable deletion
- `Observability`: exporter success/failure events emitted to telemetry with tenant id, bytes exported, duration, error code
- `Backpressure`: exporter respects per-tenant rate limit config and exposes backoff error code

sam: Engineering concerns:
- resumable export requires chunked upload + checkpointing — adds complexity but doable
- soft-delete window requires metadata retention and admin restore api
- need schema for telemetry events

jess: UX acceptance checks:
- mock shows clear states: queued, in-progress, partial-fail, complete, restored
- export modal shows bytes and estimated time, with CTA for retry :eyes:

ashley: Ops acceptance:
- danger test: simulate 1000 concurrent exports from single region — system must keep >=99% of control-plane success and queue rest
- billing alert integration for unexpected egress

maria: Ok. Next steps:
- @sam to write rough tech approach + estimate by EOD tomorrow
- @jess to post mocks in #design by EOD today
- @ashley to list SRE constraints and alerts
- @oliver to slot MLP into next sprint planning and update roadmap doc

sam: ack, will post a short RFC doc (design+impl) with open questions

jess: uploading mocks in 10m :thumbsup:

observability-bot: New alert policy draft created: export_e2e_failure_rate

maria: Thanks all. If anyone thinks auto-export must be in initial launch speak up now or we'll tab it for follow-up. :thumbsup:
